content:
I would like to take on a scoped piece of the BCIKS20 correlated-agreement formalization. Quang directed me here to share my proposal, so here goes:

Proposed scope: the weighted (mu-measure) correlated-agreement layer in ProximityGap/BCIKS20/WeightedAgreement.lean. Concretely, Lemmas 7.5 and 7.6 (the list-agreement-on-a-curve bounds) as the foundation, then the two weighted-correlated-agreement-over-affine-spaces theorems, reducing them onto the already-proven unweighted correlatedAgreement_affine_spaces.

That file looks orphaned and untouched by current PRs. To stay clear of @alexanderlhicks's #497 (the rational-function and Appendix-A work), I would explicitly leave all of ListDecoding/* and the two weighted-curve theorems (lines 32 and 67) out of scope.

Before I start: does anyone see overlap, or have a different priority for this layer? If it is clear, I will begin with Lemma 7.5 and write the work up as a Verified-zkEVM proposal.
